text_zh:
我国攻克硅基量子芯片关键材料，实现丰度超
99.99%的硅-28同位素自主量产
6月15日，中核集团宣布，我国科学家在稳定同位素富集与高纯硅制备领域取得关键性突破，首次成功实现丰度超过99.99%的硅-28同位素自主量产，产品关键指标达国际先进水平。该项成果由中核集团旗下中国原子能工业有限公司所属核工业理化工程研究院研发，其突破标志着我国在构建自主可控、协同高效的稳定同位素产业格局方面迈出实质性步伐，将为我国硅基量子计算核心材料的自主研制以及先进制程半导体、高端导航、计量基准等前沿科技领域高质量发展提供坚实支撑。
来源：
https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/vGsMcRYstu0X4oj4o3UbBw
QuEra计划于2028年推出容错量子计算机，并深化与AWS合作
6月15日，量子计算领军企业
QuEra宣布，计划于2028年推出名为“Libra”的容错量子计算机。与此同时，QuEra显著扩大了与亚马逊云服务（AWS）开展的多年期战略合作，旨在将该量子计算机引入Amazon Braket云平台。这一合作将为全球用户提供更稳定、更深度的量子计算云端访问服务。
来源：
https://www.quera.com/press-releases/quera-announces-2028-fault-tolerant-quantum-computer-and-expanded-multi-year-strategic-collaboration-with-aws
Quantinuum
等公开具备全连通性
98
量子比特离子阱量子计算机实测数据
本研究报道了
Quantinuum Helios——一款基于QCCD架构的98比特¹³⁷Ba离子阱处理器，依靠可旋转离子存储环实现全比特互连，搭配并行门操作与动态程序实时编译软件栈。研究实现了单量子比特门平均保真度99.9975%（错误率2.5×10⁻⁵）、两量子比特门平均保真度99.92%（错误率7.9×10⁻⁴），以及态制备与测量（SPAM）错误率3.3×10⁻⁴，这些指标均未达到基本原理极限，仍有进一步提升空间。随机线路采样实验证明其计算复杂度超出经典模拟能力，为高保真、大规模量子计算开辟全新前沿。研究成果于6月17日发表于《Nature》（自然）。
来源：
https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10676-4
以色列创新局与
DDR&D/MAFAT启动1.5亿新谢克尔计划，推动下一代光子芯片发展
6月14日，以色列创新局和国防部下属国防研究与发展局（DDR&D/MAFAT）合作，启动了一项价值高达1.5亿新谢克尔（约5140万美元）的新计划，旨在建立先进的集成光子学基础设施，以加速以色列光子芯片的开发和商业化。所选设施将为企业、初创企业和学术研究人员提供端到端的研发服务——包括设计、仿真、原型制作、测试、包装以及向制造规模化的支持。该项目旨在弥合以色列强大科研能力与有限的后期开发基础设施之间的关键差距，旨在增强国家在战略重要半导体和国防技术领域的竞争力。
来源：
https://innovationisrael.org.il/en/press_release/integrated-photonics-rnd/
英日签署前沿技术伙伴关系协议，深化量子技术等关键领域合作
6月14日，
英国首相斯塔默与日本首相高市早苗在伦敦正式签署《英日前沿技术伙伴关系》协议。两国将结合英国在软件与研究领域的优势，以及日本在硬件和制造方面的实力，深化在人工智能（AI）、量子技术、网络安全及半导体供应链等关键及新兴领域的研发与商业合作，以共同应对地缘政治挑战并促进两国的经济韧性。

https://www.gov.uk/government/news/uk-japan-frontier-technology-partnership
德国启动
CHIRON项目，构建可扩展量子通信网络
6月15日，
德国正式启动
CHIRON项目。该项目汇聚了德国顶尖研究机构与科技企业，旨在利用基于纠缠的量子密钥分发（QKD）技术，打造一个高可扩展性的量子通信基础设施。此举意在应对AI攻击和未来量子计算带来的安全威胁，全面保障欧洲数字网络的长远安全。

https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/06/15/chiron-project-launches-quantum-communication-network-initiative/

1000
万英镑战略投资

法国采购
Alice&Bob
量子比特计算机，用于国家研究基础设施
6月17日，
法国国家高性能计算机构
GENCI与Alice&Bob签署协议，法国将采购一台18猫量子比特量子计算机，标志着全球首次部署猫量子比特系统。该系统将安装在TGCC并与Joliot-Curie超级计算机集成，预计用户访问将于2027年开始。该项目是法国国家量子战略的一部分，旨在支持量子纠错和高性能计算-量子计算混合工作流程的研究。

HPE）宣布扩大与英特尔（Intel）、IQM、Qblox、Quantinuum、QuEra Computing、Quantum Machines、Rigetti及Riverlane等知名企业的行业研究合作关系。此举旨在深化各方在量子计算、超算、高性能计算以及AI创新等领域的联合研究，共同加速“混合经典-量子计算”技术的规模化发展与实际应用。

为了应对人工智能与量子技术时代的网络安全挑战，
DigitalXForce宣布推出行业首个企业级TRiSCM（信任、风险与安全管理）平台。该平台旨在为数字化转型的企业提供一体化的安全管理方案，实时评估并量化技术演进带来的多维安全风险，全面提升量子时代的数智信任与防御能力。

Atom Computing与Phasecraft达成战略合作，推动实用量子计算发展

中性原子量子计算领军企业
Atom Computing与量子算法公司Phasecraft宣布签署合作备忘录。双方将通过把Phasecraft的硬件自适应算法与Atom Computing的1200+比特中性原子量子硬件相结合，重点加速电池和光伏等下一代材料科学与能源领域的应用开发，共同推动实用级量子计算的落地进程。

获美国
ARPA-E
支持，将利用量子算法研发新一代催化剂

量子算法公司
Phasecraft宣布获得美国能源部高级研究计划署（ARPA-E）的资金支持。该公司将利用先进的量子算法，专注于清洁能源等领域的催化剂设计与新材料发现。此举旨在加速量子计算在解决现实世界材料与优化挑战中的落地，推动实用量子优势的早日实现。

筹集超
3
亿美元资金，加速部署容错中性原子量子计算机

Atom Computing宣布，截至目前已筹集超过3亿美元资金，其中包括由Third Point Ventures主导的1亿美元C轮融资，以及美国商务部计划中的1亿美元融资，以加快容错量子计算机的开发和部署。继近期的技术和商业里程碑之后，Atom Computing已成为构建公用规模量子计算机竞赛的领导者。近期资金将加速全球企业和政府客户大规模开发和交付商业本地量子系统。

Zapata Quantum
宣布升格至
OTCQB
市场，以提升交易流动性

Zapata Quantum宣布其股票开始在OTCQB风险投资市场交易，标志着其在国家证券交易所上市目标迈出了一步。公司表示，OTCQB的上级上市预计将提升其在机构和散户投资者中的可见度、可及性和交易流动性。首席执行官苏米特·卡普尔表示，Zapata正将自己定位为美国唯一一家上市的纯量子软件公司，理由是其知识产权组合、商业经验以及与哈佛量子计算实验室创始团队的联系。

Quandela
入选
DARPA
量子基准测试计划
A
阶段
6月16日，Quandela被选为DARPA量子基准测试计划A阶段的成员，该计划评估任何量子计算架构是否能在2033年前实现公用事业规模的性能。在该项目下，Quandela将开发并捍卫一个容错、公用事业规模量子计算机的概念，提供技术证据，证明其方法在短期内可行。公司计划推进其自旋光子架构，结合光子网络与半导体自旋技术，作为迈向可扩展量子计算系统的路径，进而推进到后续的QBI阶段，包括验证和风险降低。

SEEQC
获准参与美国芯片法案支持的微电子共享体
NORDTECH
量子研发项目
6月16日，
SEEQC宣布已加入为期四年的NORDTECH项目，旨在推动美国采用300毫米工业硅晶圆的超导量子芯片可扩展制造工艺。作为NY CREATES的分包商，SEEKC将贡献低温量子比特测试能力，支持制造反馈环路，在Cadence生态系统内开发量子工艺设计套件，并协助将设计与其基于SFQ的数字控制技术整合。该倡议汇聚学术界、产业界和政府合作伙伴，共同改进量子比特材料和制造方法，同时加强国内量子供应链和劳动力发展。

与
Roadrunner Venture Studios

量子研究与孵化组织
Quantum Catalyzer（Q-Cat）与Roadrunner Venture Studios宣布建立战略合作伙伴关系，以加速美国商业量子技术公司的创建与扩展。在该联盟下，Q-Cat将提供专业的深度技术尽职调查、知识产权验证和技术可行性跟踪，指导Roadrunner Venture Studios流程。通过将严谨的科学评估直接融入风险投资创建的早期阶段，该合作旨在降低硬技术创新的风险，弥合初步实验室突破与可扩展风险投资市场进入之间的运营差距。

Quantum Art
验证利用多量子比特门实现容错量子计算的可扩展路径
6月16日，
Quantum Art宣布了其多量子比特门架构能够推动可扩展容错量子计算的研究成果，并通过详细的微观噪声模型和全面的容错模拟验证。公司通过构建多量子比特门的真实噪声建模，并分析这些模型在可扩展纠错码中的表现，展示了其架构支持容错操作。结果显示了一种有限阈值行为，例如使用表面码，适用于可扩展容错量子计算。仿真结果显示，随着系统扩展，逻辑纠错能力持续提升，验证了Quantum Art的多量子比特门架构能够支持一条可扩展的逻辑量子比特路径和容错量子计算。

与丰田通商合作，在日本部署首个企业级光量子计算系统

与

和
Orbray
合作，加速晶圆级单晶钻石的批量生产

Element Six和Orbray正推动晶圆级单晶钻石向商业化生产推进，应用于量子技术、6G和电力电子。合作伙伴已建立了3英寸钻石晶圆的可重复工艺，并正在开发更大的4英寸基底。Element Six正在为2英寸钻石晶圆准备量产，随着合作从研发转向制造规模化。

与

# Weekly Report | China Achieves Key Material Breakthrough for Silicon-Based Quantum Chips, Realizing Domestic Mass Production of Silicon-28 Isotope with Purity Exceeding 99.99%; QuEra Plans to Launch Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computer in 2028…

---

## China Achieves Key Material Breakthrough for Silicon-Based Quantum Chips, Realizing Domestic Mass Production of Silicon-28 Isotope with Purity Exceeding 99.99%

On June 15, China National Nuclear Corporation (CNNC) announced that Chinese scientists have achieved a critical breakthrough in stable isotope enrichment and high-purity silicon preparation, successfully realizing domestic mass production of silicon-28 isotope with an abundance exceeding 99.99% for the first time. Key product metrics have reached internationally advanced levels. The achievement was developed by the Nuclear Industry Physics and Chemistry Research Institute, a subsidiary of China Atomic Energy Industry Co., Ltd. (CAEI) under CNNC. This breakthrough marks a substantive step forward in establishing an independently controlled and collaboratively efficient stable isotope industrial ecosystem in China. It will provide robust support for the domestic development of core materials for silicon-based quantum computing, as well as for advanced semiconductor processes, high-end navigation, metrology standards, and other frontier technology sectors.

**Source:** https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/vGsMcRYstu0X4oj4o3UbBw

---

## QuEra Plans to Launch Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computer in 2028, Deepens Collaboration with AWS

On June 15, quantum computing leader QuEra announced plans to launch a fault-tolerant quantum computer named "Libra" in 2028. Simultaneously, QuEra significantly expanded its multi-year strategic collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS), aimed at bringing the quantum computer onto the Amazon Braket cloud platform. This collaboration will provide global users with more stable and deeper cloud access to quantum computing.

**Source:** https://www.quera.com/press-releases/quera-announces-2028-fault-tolerant-quantum-computer-and-expanded-multi-year-strategic-collaboration-with-aws

## Quantinuum and Collaborators Publish Benchmark Data for a 98-Qubit Fully Connected Ion Trap Quantum Computer

This study reports on Quantinuum Helios — a 98-qubit ¹³⁷Ba ion trap processor based on the QCCD (Quantum Charge-Coupled Device) architecture. Full qubit connectivity is achieved via a rotatable ion storage ring, complemented by parallel gate operations and a dynamic real-time program compilation software stack. The research achieved an average single-qubit gate fidelity of 99.9975% (error rate 2.5×10⁻⁵), an average two-qubit gate fidelity of 99.92% (error rate 7.9×10⁻⁴), and a state preparation and measurement (SPAM) error rate of 3.3×10⁻⁴ — all of which have not yet reached the fundamental physical limits and remain open to further improvement. Random circuit sampling experiments demonstrate computational complexity that exceeds classical simulation capabilities, opening a new frontier in high-fidelity, large-scale quantum computing. The results were published in *Nature* on June 17.

**Source:** https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10676-4

## Israel Innovation Authority and DDR&D/MAFAT Launch NIS 150 Million Program to Advance Next-Generation Photonic Chips

On June 14, the Israel Innovation Authority and the Defense Research and Development Directorate (DDR&D/MAFAT) under the Ministry of Defense jointly launched a program valued at up to NIS 150 million (approximately USD 51.4 million), aimed at establishing advanced integrated photonics infrastructure to accelerate the development and commercialization of photonic chips in Israel. The selected facility will provide end-to-end R&D services — including design, simulation, prototyping, testing, packaging, and support for scaling to manufacturing — to companies, startups, and academic researchers. The program aims to bridge the critical gap between Israel's strong research capabilities and its limited late-stage development infrastructure, with the goal of enhancing the country's competitiveness in strategically important semiconductor and defense technology sectors.

**Source:** https://innovationisrael.org.il/en/press_release/integrated-photonics-rnd/

## UK and Japan Sign Frontier Technology Partnership Agreement, Deepening Cooperation in Quantum Technology and Other Key Fields

On June 14, UK Prime Minister Starmer and Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae formally signed the UK-Japan Frontier Technology Partnership agreement in London. The two countries will combine the UK's strengths in software and research with Japan's capabilities in hardware and manufacturing, deepening R&D and commercial collaboration in critical and emerging fields including artificial intelligence (AI), quantum technology, cybersecurity, and semiconductor supply chains. The partnership aims to jointly address geopolitical challenges and promote economic resilience in both nations.

**Source:** https://www.gov.uk/government/news/uk-japan-frontier-technology-partnership

## Germany Launches CHIRON Project to Build a Scalable Quantum Communication Network

On June 15, Germany officially launched the CHIRON project. The initiative brings together Germany's leading research institutions and technology companies, aiming to build a highly scalable quantum communication infrastructure using entanglement-based quantum key distribution (QKD) technology. The project is designed to address security threats posed by AI-based attacks and future quantum computing, with the broad goal of comprehensively safeguarding the long-term security of European digital networks.

**Source:** https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/06/15/chiron-project-launches-quantum-communication-network-initiative/

## UK Government Launches National Quantum Standards Network with £10 Million Strategic Investment

On June 16, the UK Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT) formally launched the Quantum Standards Network (QSN), supported by a £10 million strategic investment. Science Minister Lord Vallance announced that this infrastructure project will be led and established by the National Physical Laboratory (NPL), with the aim of establishing common technical rules for quantum hardware and software architectures. Serving as an end-to-end regulatory blueprint, the initiative brings together government agencies, industrial manufacturers, academic institutions, and national bodies to ensure that emerging UK deep-tech products are engineered to internationally recognized performance benchmarks, thereby maximizing export potential.

**Source:** https://www.gov.uk/government/news/worlds-first-national-network-for-quantum-standards-to-boost-uk-leadership-and-trade-in-groundbreaking-future-tech

## France Procures Alice&Bob Qubit Computer for National Research Infrastructure

On June 17, France's national high-performance computing agency GENCI (Grand Équipement National de Calcul Intensif) signed an agreement with Alice&Bob to procure an 18-cat-qubit quantum computer, marking the world's first deployment of a cat qubit system. The system will be installed at TGCC (Très Grand Centre de Calcul) and integrated with the Joliot-Curie supercomputer; user access is expected to begin in 2027. The project is part of France's national quantum strategy and aims to support research in quantum error correction (QEC) and HPC–quantum hybrid computing workflows.

## HPE Announces Expanded Industry Collaborations to Accelerate Hybrid Classical–Quantum Computing

On June 15, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) announced the expansion of its industry research collaborations with Intel, IQM, Qblox, Quantinuum, QuEra Computing, Quantum Machines, Rigetti, and Riverlane. The move aims to deepen joint research across quantum computing, supercomputing, high-performance computing (HPC), and AI innovation, and to jointly accelerate the scaled development and practical application of hybrid classical–quantum computing.

## WiMi Introduces Quantum Kernel Convolution Architecture for NISQ Devices

On June 15, WiMi announced the launch of a core technology for hybrid quantum convolutional neural networks (QCNNs), proposing and implementing a quantum kernel convolution (QKC) scheme capable of running on current noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. As a globally leading holographic augmented reality (AR) technology provider, WiMi's initiative demonstrates its latest breakthrough in the quantum AI field. The scheme aims to overcome the noise limitations of current quantum devices, laying an important foundation for advancing quantum computing applications in real-world scenarios such as image processing and complex pattern recognition.

## DigitalXForce Launches Industry's First Enterprise TRiSCM Platform to Address Cybersecurity Risks

On June 15, to address cybersecurity challenges in the era of artificial intelligence and quantum technology, DigitalXForce announced the launch of the industry's first enterprise-grade TRiSCM (Trust, Risk, and Security Management) platform. The platform is designed to provide digitally transforming enterprises with a unified security management solution that delivers real-time assessment and quantification of multi-dimensional security risks arising from technological evolution, comprehensively enhancing digital trust and defensive capabilities in the quantum era.

On June 15, neutral-atom quantum computing leader Atom Computing and quantum algorithm company Phasecraft announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding (MOU). On June 15, quantum algorithm company Phasecraft announced it has received funding from the U.S. Department of Energy's Advanced Research Projects Agency-Energy (ARPA-E). The company will leverage advanced quantum algorithms to focus on catalyst design and new materials discovery in areas including clean energy. This initiative aims to accelerate the deployment of quantum computing in addressing real-world materials and optimization challenges, driving the early realization of practical quantum advantage.

On June 16, Atom Computing announced that it has raised over $300 million to date, including a $100 million Series C round led by Third Point Ventures and a planned $100 million investment from the U.S. Department of Commerce, to accelerate the development and deployment of fault-tolerant quantum computers. The company stated that the uplisting to OTCQB is expected to improve its visibility, accessibility, and trading liquidity among institutional and retail investors. On June 16, Quandela was selected as a member of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (QBI) Stage A, a program that evaluates whether any quantum computing architecture can achieve utility-scale performance before 2033. Under this program, Quandela will develop and defend a concept for a fault-tolerant, utility-scale quantum computer, providing technical evidence that its approach is achievable in the near term. The company plans to advance its spin-photonic architecture — combining photonic networks with semiconductor spin technology — as a pathway toward scalable quantum computing systems, with the goal of progressing to subsequent QBI stages, including validation and risk reduction.

By constructing realistic noise models for multi-qubit gates and analyzing the performance of these models within scalable error-correcting codes, the company demonstrated that its architecture supports fault-tolerant operations. ## EPB Quantum to Host Inaugural Quantum in Business Event in Chattanooga

On June 16, EPB Quantum announced it will host the inaugural Quantum in Business (QiB) conference on October 1, 2026, in Chattanooga, aimed at helping enterprises explore near-term quantum computing opportunities. The event will feature speakers from EPB, IonQ, Oak Ridge National Laboratory, and other organizations to discuss quantum strategy, adoption, and commercialization. The conference will explore the potential applications of quantum computing in finance, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing, chemistry, automotive, and insurance sectors.

**Source:** https://quantum.epb.com/qib26/agenda/

## IQM and Real Asset Acquisition Corp. Host Inaugural Capital Markets Day

On June 17, Finnish quantum computing company IQM and blank-check company Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAC) co-hosted their inaugural Capital Markets Day event, presenting the company's latest commercial progress and technology roadmap to investors and analysts. As a leading European quantum computing enterprise, IQM has continued to advance its hardware and software product lines (including the Spark and Radiance series) while accelerating commercialization and industrial collaboration in the superconducting quantum computing domain. This event represents an important initiative by the company to deepen capital market communications and showcase its future growth potential, drawing broad attention from the technology and investment communities.

**Source:** https://iqm.tech/press-releases/iqm-and-real-asset-acquisition-corp-host-inaugural-capital-markets-day-for-investors-and-analysts/
